title: Tsonga dance tutorial | Xibelani | SA YouTuber

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is encouraging and conversational, blending theoretical explanation with practical demonstration. She breaks down movements step by step and checks for common posture mistakes.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome and intro to the Xibelani tutorial
Discussion on comfortable shoes and posture
Demonstrating the hip movement with different angles

cues: make sure that you are wearing comfortable shoes
common_mistakes: moving shoulders or upper body instead of keeping it still
boxing or trying to fight someone with arms
safety: make sure that you have comfortable shoes before you start this stuff, especially if you're still trying to learn, because you don't want to incur some injuries

steps_taught.name: Xibelani waist shaking
steps_taught.description: Isolating movement in the lower body/waist while keeping the upper body still.

what_works: breaking down the upper and lower body separation clearly
what_hinders: long conversational intros before getting into the movement

quotes.text: You need to make sure that you are wearing comfortable shoes.
With Xibelani you dance with your waist, you dance with your lower body.
You need to make sure that your upper body is not moving.
You can start off with this position.
So now that we have the Xibelani on, let us try and see what I'm saying makes sense.
